scope: Four bounded child-signal lifetime cases through four shell aliases compare native GNU with the immutable Rboxc candidate. Includes repeated dispatch, active replacement/reset and function status preservation. All child jobs belong to the test. Complete parent and child Valgrind summaries are required. Native findings remain baseline observations; this is focused ownership evidence, not full Bash acceptance.

results.name: bash:repeat
args: -c
trap ':' CHLD; for ((i=0;i<12;i++)); do : & wait; done; trap - CHLD; printf 'complete\n'

results.name: bash:replace
args: -c
seen=; trap 'seen=yes; trap "seen=yes" CHLD' CHLD; : & wait; trap - CHLD; printf 'seen:%s\n' "$seen"

results.name: bash:reset
args: -c
seen=; trap 'seen=yes; trap - CHLD' CHLD; : & wait; printf 'seen:%s\n' "$seen"

results.name: bash:function
args: -c
f(){ seen=; trap 'seen=yes' CHLD; : & wait; trap - CHLD; printf 'seen:%s\n' "$seen"; return 7; }; f; printf 'status:%s\n' "$?"
